# 7. Drought (SPEI)

```{r spei}
# 6-month SPEI on a monthly time step (accumulation period ag_n months)
ag_n <- 6
freq <- 12   # monthly time step; event durations below are divided by freq to report years

agg_wbm <- wbm %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ym = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ym, CF) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    precip_in_wbm = sum(precip_in_wbm, na.rm = TRUE),
    tmean_C       = mean(tmean_C,       na.rm = TRUE),
    pet_in_wbm    = sum(pet_in_wbm,     na.rm = TRUE),
    runoff_in_wbm = sum(runoff_in_wbm,  na.rm = TRUE),
    runoff_gal    = sum(runoff_gal,      na.rm = TRUE),
    snow_in_wbm   = sum(snow_in_wbm,    na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    balance = precip_in_wbm - pet_in_wbm,
    year    = year(ym),
    month   = month(ym)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(CF, ym)

# Helper: compute SPEI for one CF scenario appended to the historical record, so
# each future is referenced to the same historical normalization period
compute_spei_for_cf <- function(agg_wbm_df, target_cf) {
  d <- agg_wbm_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(CF %in% c("Historical", target_cf)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(ym)
  d %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      spei = as.numeric(spei(
        ts(balance, start = c(year(min(ym)), month(min(ym))), frequency = freq),
        scale     = ag_n,
        # Standardize to the same 1980-2012 baseline used for every other
        # historical-vs-future comparison in the report
        ref.start = c(hist_yrs[1], 1),
        ref.end   = c(hist_yrs[2], 12)
      )[["fitted"]])
    )
}

spei_hot_dry  <- compute_spei_for_cf(agg_wbm, "Hot Dry")
spei_warm_wet <- compute_spei_for_cf(agg_wbm, "Warm Wet")

# Combine: Historical and Warm Wet rows from the Warm Wet fit, Hot Dry rows from the Hot Dry fit
spei <- bind_rows(
  spei_hot_dry  %>% dplyr::filter(CF == "Hot Dry"),
  spei_warm_wet
) %>%
  # A few late-century Hot Dry months fall below the support of the log-logistic
  # fit to the 1980-2012 baseline and return -Inf; cap SPEI at +/-3 (beyond the
  # extreme-drought threshold, so category counts are unaffected)
  dplyr::mutate(spei = pmin(pmax(spei, -3), 3))

# Statistics use the baseline window for Historical and the future window for each CF
spei_in_window <- function(df) {
  df %>% dplyr::filter((CF == "Historical" & in_hist(year)) |
                       (CF != "Historical" & in_fut(year)))
}

# --- Drought Severity and Duration Metrics ---

# Severity summary: fraction of time in moderate / severe / extreme drought
spei_severity <- spei %>%
  spei_in_window() %>%
  drop_na(spei) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    moderate = spei <= -1,
    severe   = spei <= -1.5,
    extreme  = spei <= -2
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    n            = n(),
    mod_percent  = 100 * sum(moderate, na.rm = TRUE) / n,
    sev_percent  = 100 * sum(severe,   na.rm = TRUE) / n,
    ext_percent  = 100 * sum(extreme,  na.rm = TRUE) / n,
    mean_spei    = mean(spei),
    median_spei  = median(spei, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_spei      = sd(spei,     na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Helper: summarize drought event duration stats for one severity level
calc_event_durations <- function(spei_df, flag_col, event_col, suffix) {
  spei_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[flag_col]]) %>%
    group_by(CF, .data[[event_col]]) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(duration = n(), mean_spei = mean(spei, na.rm = TRUE),
                     .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(CF) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(
      # durations in months (monthly SPEI, so one row = one month)
      !!paste0(suffix, "_mean_duration")   := mean(duration, na.rm = TRUE),
      !!paste0(suffix, "_max_duration")    := max(duration,  na.rm = TRUE),
      !!paste0(suffix, "_median_duration") := median(duration, na.rm = TRUE),
      !!paste0(suffix, "_mean_spei")       := mean(mean_spei, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
}

spei_frequency <- spei %>%
  spei_in_window() %>%
  drop_na(spei) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    moderate  = spei <= -1,
    severe    = spei <= -1.5,
    extreme   = spei <= -2
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mod_event = cumsum(moderate & !lag(moderate, default = FALSE)),
    sev_event = cumsum(severe   & !lag(severe,   default = FALSE)),
    ext_event = cumsum(extreme  & !lag(extreme,  default = FALSE))
  )

spei_metrics <- calc_event_durations(spei_frequency, "moderate", "mod_event", "mod") %>%
  left_join(calc_event_durations(spei_frequency, "severe",   "sev_event", "sev"), by = "CF") %>%
  left_join(calc_event_durations(spei_frequency, "extreme",  "ext_event", "ext"), by = "CF") %>%
  left_join(spei_severity, by = "CF") %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame(stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  row_to_names(row_number = 1) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Metric") %>%
  arrange(Metric)

# Late-century context: longest drought events (years) over the full projection
# period (2026-2099), outside the statistics window used for the drought table
max_run_yrs <- function(x) {
  r <- rle(x)
  if (any(r$values)) max(r$lengths[r$values]) / freq else 0
}
spei_full_period_durations <- spei %>%
  dplyr::filter(CF != "Historical", year >= 2026, year <= 2099) %>%
  drop_na(spei) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(CF, ym) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    mod_max_duration_yrs = max_run_yrs(spei <= -1),
    sev_max_duration_yrs = max_run_yrs(spei <= -1.5),
    ext_max_duration_yrs = max_run_yrs(spei <= -2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
save_table(spei_full_period_durations, "spei_max_durations_2026_2099")

# Quick scatter: SPEI vs July snowmelt
ggplot(spei %>% dplyr::filter(month(ym) == 7),
       aes(x = spei, y = snow_in_wbm)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(fill = "orange", color = "maroon", alpha = 0.2) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "SPEI", y = "Snowmelt (in)")
```


# 5. Tables

##### Table 1: Runoff change 

Annual runoff summary statistics for historical and future periods, including % change.

```{r table_1}
change <- wbm_annual %>%
  filter(in_window(year)) %>%
  mutate(stat_group = ifelse(in_hist(year), "Hist", "Fut")) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(stat_group, CF, runoff_gal, inflow_open_months_gal) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF, stat_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarize_all(.funs = list(mean = mean, sd = sd)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(stat_group != "Present",
                !(stat_group == "Hist" & CF == "Hot Dry"),
                !(stat_group == "Hist" & CF == "Warm Wet")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-stat_group) %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  set_names(.[1, ]) %>%
  slice(-1) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.))))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    `Hot Dry % Change`  = 100 * (`Hot Dry`  - Historical) / Historical,
    `Warm Wet % Change` = 100 * (`Warm Wet` - Historical) / Historical
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(c(Historical, `Hot Dry`, `Warm Wet`), ~ .x / 1e6)) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "row_key") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Component = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("runoff", row_key) ~ "Runoff",
      grepl("inflow", row_key) ~ "Inflow"
    ),
    Statistic = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("_mean$", row_key) ~ "Mean",
      grepl("_sd$",   row_key) ~ "Standard Deviation"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(row_order = dplyr::case_when(
    Component == "Runoff" & Statistic == "Mean"               ~ 1,
    Component == "Runoff" & Statistic == "Standard Deviation" ~ 2,
    Component == "Inflow" & Statistic == "Mean"               ~ 3,
    Component == "Inflow" & Statistic == "Standard Deviation" ~ 4
  )) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(row_order) %>%
  dplyr::select(Component, Statistic, Historical, `Hot Dry`, `Warm Wet`,
                `Hot Dry % Change`, `Warm Wet % Change`)

save_table(change, "table_runoff_inflow_change")
kable(change,
    caption = "Runoff and Inflow statistics (millions of gallons)"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r drought_metrics}
drought_table <- spei_metrics %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Category  = case_when(
      grepl("ext", Metric) ~ "Extreme",
      grepl("mod", Metric) ~ "Moderate",
      grepl("sev", Metric) ~ "Severe",
      TRUE                 ~ "Overall"
    ),
    Statistic = case_when(
      grepl("mean_duration",   Metric) ~ "Mean Duration (months)",
      grepl("max_duration",    Metric) ~ "Maximum Duration (months)",
      grepl("mean_spei",       Metric) ~ "Mean (SPEI)",
      grepl("median_spei",     Metric) ~ "Median (SPEI)",
      grepl("percent",         Metric) ~ "% of Period",
      grepl("median_duration", Metric) ~ "Median Duration (months)",
      grepl("sd_spei",         Metric) ~ "Standard Deviation",
      Metric == "n"                    ~ "n (months)",

    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    factor(Category,   levels = c("Overall", "Moderate", "Severe", "Extreme")),  # ← primary sort

                                   "Standard Deviation", "n (months)", "Mean Duration (months)",
                                   "Median Duration (months)", "Maximum Duration (months)"))   # ← secondary sort
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Category, Statistic, Historical, `Hot Dry`, `Warm Wet`) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3)))
```

##### Table 4: Storage:Demand Ratio

```{r table_storage}
storage_vol <- 10000  # 10,000-gallon tank

SD <- monthly_use_proportions %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    month_days = days_in_month(as.Date(paste0("2000-", month, "-01")))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(mid_use_hist, high_use_hist, mid_use_fut, high_use_fut),
    names_to  = "use_cat",
    values_to = "monthly_use"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(use_cat) %>%
  dplyr::filter(monthly_use == max(monthly_use, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    avg_daily_use  = monthly_use / month_days,
    peak_daily_use = avg_daily_use * 2,
    SD_monthly     = storage_vol / monthly_use,
    SD_daily       = storage_vol / peak_daily_use,
    days_avg       = storage_vol / avg_daily_use,
    days_peak      = storage_vol / peak_daily_use
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(use_cat, month, month_days, monthly_use,
                avg_daily_use, peak_daily_use,
                SD_monthly, SD_daily,
                days_avg, days_peak) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3)))

save_table(SD, "table_storage_demand")
kable(SD)
```

```{r runoff_differentials_range}
inflow_labels <- future_differentials %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(delta_seasonal_inflow_per,
                delta_seasonal_inflow_low_per,
                delta_seasonal_inflow_high_per) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "var", values_to = "vals") %>%
  mutate(var = fct_recode(var,
                  "Low"      = "delta_seasonal_inflow_low_per",
                  "Best-fit" = "delta_seasonal_inflow_per",
                  "High"     = "delta_seasonal_inflow_high_per") %>%
         fct_relevel("Low", "Best-fit", "High")) %>%
  group_by(var) %>%
  summarize(
    label_min = round(min(vals, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    label_max = round(max(vals, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    y_min     = min(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    y_max     = max(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

inflow_range_fig <- ggplot(future_differentials %>%
         dplyr::ungroup() %>%
         dplyr::select(delta_seasonal_inflow_per,
                       delta_seasonal_inflow_low_per,

         pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "var", values_to = "vals") %>%
         mutate(var = fct_recode(var,
                         "Low"      = "delta_seasonal_inflow_low_per",
                         "Best-fit" = "delta_seasonal_inflow_per",
                         "High"     = "delta_seasonal_inflow_high_per") %>%
                fct_relevel("Low", "Best-fit", "High"))) +
  geom_violin(aes(x = var, y = vals, fill = var), alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(aes(x = var, y = vals, fill = var),
              shape = 21, color = "black",
              width = 0.1, size = 1.5, alpha = 1) +
  geom_text(data = inflow_labels,
            aes(x = var, y = y_min, label = label_min),
            vjust = 1.5, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data = inflow_labels,
            aes(x = var, y = y_max, label = label_max),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(accuracy = 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.1))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Seasonal Inflow \nPercentage Change") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_manual("",  values = c("lightblue1", "dodgerblue", pal$darkblue)) +
```

##### Site Figure

Map of the Logan Pass water system on the NPS Park Tiles basemap
(https://www.nps.gov/maps/tools/park-tiles/, via `get_nps_basemap()` /
`geom_nps_basemap()` in `src/nps_basemap.R`, adapted from the MORA WSVA),
with a shadow-only hillshade from the 1 m lidar DTM so the alpine terrain of
the contributing area reads clearly. A locator inset is joined to the main
map in code with `patchwork::inset_element()`.

```{r figure_site}
# --- 1. Map extent: contributing area + Logan Pass facilities, padded --------
site_fig_bbox_utm <- st_union(st_union(st_geometry(st_transform(recharge_area, 26912))),
                              st_union(st_geometry(st_transform(sel_bldg, 26912)))) %>%
  st_buffer(700) %>%
  st_bbox()
site_fig_bbox <- site_fig_bbox_utm %>% st_as_sfc() %>% st_transform(3857) %>% st_bbox()

# --- 2. NPS Park Tiles basemaps (main map and inset) --------------------------
# Tiles are Web Mercator (EPSG:3857), so everything else is projected to match
site_tiles <- cache_download("park_tiles_site_z15", get_nps_basemap(
  aoi = st_as_sf(st_as_sfc(site_fig_bbox)), style = "standard", buffer_km = 0.3, zoom = 15))
inset_tiles <- cache_download("park_tiles_inset_z9", get_nps_basemap(
  aoi = park_boundary, style = "standard", buffer_km = 3, zoom = 9))

# --- 3. Lidar hillshade --------------------------------------------------------
# The delineation DTM covers only the catchment, so read a 3 m window over the
# full map extent from the same USGS 3DEP 1 m tiles
site_fig_dem_path <- file.path(lidar_dir, "lidar_DTM_site_fig_3m.tif")
if (!file.exists(site_fig_dem_path)) {
  site_fig_window <- ext(site_fig_bbox_utm[c("xmin", "xmax", "ymin", "ymax")]) + 400
  site_fig_dem <- purrr::map(lidar_tiles, ~ crop(rast(paste0(lidar_base, .x)), site_fig_window)) %>%
    unname() %>%
    do.call(terra::merge, .) %>%
    terra::aggregate(3, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  writeRaster(site_fig_dem, site_fig_dem_path, gdal = "COMPRESS=DEFLATE", overwrite = TRUE)
}
site_fig_dem <- rast(site_fig_dem_path)

# Multidirectional hillshade (sun from W, NW, N) is softer than a single sun
# angle and prints well
site_slope  <- terrain(site_fig_dem, "slope", unit = "radians")
site_aspect <- terrain(site_fig_dem, "aspect", unit = "radians")
site_hs <- purrr::map(c(270, 315, 360), ~ shade(site_slope, site_aspect, angle = 40, direction = .x)) %>%
  rast() %>%
  mean() %>%
  project("EPSG:3857", res = 3)

# Draw only the shadows (dark, semi-transparent where the hillshade is low) so
# the basemap keeps its colors on lit slopes
site_hs_vals <- terra::as.matrix(site_hs, wide = TRUE)
site_hs_alpha <- pmin(1, pmax(0, 1 - site_hs_vals / max(site_hs_vals, na.rm = TRUE))) * 0.45
site_hs_alpha[is.na(site_hs_alpha)] <- 0
site_hs_rgba <- matrix(grDevices::rgb(0.08, 0.08, 0.12, site_hs_alpha), nrow = nrow(site_hs_vals))
site_hs_ext <- ext(site_hs)

# --- 4. Labels: peaks and pass (OSM), facilities, gallery ---------------------
site_peaks <- cache_download("osm_peaks_logan_pass", {
  osm <- osmdata::opq(bbox = as.numeric(st_bbox(st_transform(st_as_sfc(site_fig_bbox), 4326))),
                      timeout = 60) %>%
    osmdata::add_osm_feature("natural", c("peak", "saddle")) %>%
    osmdata::osmdata_sf()
  osm$osm_points %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(name)) %>% dplyr::select(name, natural)
})
site_peaks_3857 <- site_peaks %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    elev_ft = terra::extract(site_fig_dem, vect(st_transform(site_peaks, 26912)))[, 2] * 3.28084,
    # Park Tiles already prints GNIS summit elevations under peak names, so
    # peaks get names only; the pass gets its lidar elevation
    label = ifelse(natural == "saddle",
                   paste0(name, "\n", format(round(elev_ft, -1), big.mark = ","), " ft"),
                   name)) %>%
  st_transform(3857)

site_intake_3857 <- st_transform(select_sources, 3857)
site_bldg_3857 <- sel_bldg %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label = gsub("HBD Logan Pass Building [[:digit:]]+ ", "", BLDGNAME)) %>%
  st_centroid() %>%
  st_transform(3857)
gallery_elev_ft <- terra::extract(site_fig_dem, vect(st_transform(select_sources, 26912)))[, 2] * 3.28084

# Logan Creek label at the midpoint of its NHDPlus flowline within the map
logan_creek_lab <- flowlines %>%
  dplyr::filter(gnis_name == "Logan Creek") %>%
  st_transform(3857) %>%
  st_intersection(st_as_sfc(site_fig_bbox)) %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING") %>%
  st_line_merge() %>%
  st_cast("LINESTRING") %>%
  st_line_sample(sample = 0.5) %>%
  st_cast("POINT") %>%
  st_sf(geometry = .) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label = "Logan Creek")

st_xy <- function(x) as.data.frame(st_coordinates(x))
site_labels <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  site_bldg_3857 %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% dplyr::select(label) %>%
    dplyr::bind_cols(st_xy(site_bldg_3857)) %>% dplyr::mutate(face = "plain"),
  data.frame(label = sprintf("Infiltration gallery\n%s ft",
                             format(round(gallery_elev_ft, -1), big.mark = ",")),
             face = "bold") %>%
    dplyr::bind_cols(st_xy(site_intake_3857)))

# --- 5. Continental Divide -----------------------------------------------------
url <- "https://data.openwaterfoundation.org/country/us/usgs/continental-divide/continental-divide-us.geojson"
continental_divide <- cache_download("continental_divide", st_read(url)) %>%
  st_filter(st_buffer(park_boundary, 100) %>% st_transform(4326))

# The national line is too coarse at this scale, so locally trace the divide
# along the boundary between Pend Oreille (region 17) and Saskatchewan
# (region 09) HUC12s. HUC polygons don't share exact vertices, so keep the
# region-17 boundary wherever it lies within 30 m of region 09.
site_huc12 <- cache_download("site_fig_huc12", get_huc(
  AOI = st_buffer(st_transform(recharge_area, 26912), 2500) %>% st_bbox() %>%
    st_as_sfc() %>% st_transform(4326) %>% st_as_sf(),
  type = "huc12")) %>%
  st_transform(3857)
site_divide_3857 <- st_intersection(
  st_boundary(st_union(dplyr::filter(site_huc12, substr(huc12, 1, 2) == "17"))),
  st_buffer(st_union(dplyr::filter(site_huc12, substr(huc12, 1, 2) == "09")), 30)) %>%
  st_collection_extract("LINESTRING") %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_line_merge() %>%
  st_sf(geometry = .)

basin_cols <- c("Pend Oreille (PO)" = "hotpink", "Upper South Saskatchewan (USSR)" = "#7F96AD")
basins_3857 <- watersheds %>%
  dplyr::mutate(basin = dplyr::case_when(
    name == "McDonald Creek" ~ "Pend Oreille (PO)",                 # drains west
    name == "Reynolds Creek" ~ "Upper South Saskatchewan (USSR)"))  %>% # drains east
  st_transform(3857)

# --- 6. Main map ----------------------------------------------------------------
site_main <- ggplot() +
  geom_nps_basemap(site_tiles) +
  annotation_raster(site_hs_rgba, xmin = site_hs_ext$xmin, xmax = site_hs_ext$xmax,
                    ymin = site_hs_ext$ymin, ymax = site_hs_ext$ymax) +
  geom_sf(data = site_divide_3857, aes(linetype = "Continental Divide"), color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_sf(data = st_transform(flowlines, 3857), aes(color = "Stream (NHDPlus)"), linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = st_transform(recharge_area, 3857), aes(color = "Contributing area (1 m lidar)"),
          fill = "dodgerblue", alpha = 0.22, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_sf(data = site_bldg_3857, shape = 22, size = 2.2, fill = "grey25", color = "white", stroke = 0.6) +
  geom_sf(data = site_intake_3857, shape = 21, size = 3.2, fill = pal$darkblue, color = "white", stroke = 1) +
  geom_sf(data = dplyr::filter(site_peaks_3857, natural == "peak"),
          shape = 24, size = 2.6, fill = "grey15", color = "white", stroke = 0.6) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(data = site_labels, aes(X, Y, label = label, fontface = face),
                            size = 2.8, lineheight = 0.9, label.size = 0,
                            fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.8), min.segment.length = 0,
                            box.padding = 0.5, seed = 4, segment.color = "grey20") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = site_peaks_3857 %>% dplyr::bind_cols(st_xy(site_peaks_3857)) %>% st_drop_geometry(),
                           aes(X, Y, label = label), size = 2.8, fontface = "italic", lineheight = 0.9,
                           color = "grey10", bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.15, seed = 2, nudge_y = 120) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = logan_creek_lab %>% dplyr::bind_cols(st_xy(logan_creek_lab)) %>% st_drop_geometry(),
                           aes(X, Y, label = label), size = 2.8, fontface = "italic", color = "dodgerblue4",
                           bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.15, seed = 3, nudge_x = 250, segment.color = NA) +
  scale_color_manual("", values = c("Contributing area (1 m lidar)" = "dodgerblue4",
                                    "Stream (NHDPlus)" = "dodgerblue2")) +
  scale_linetype_manual("", values = c("Continental Divide" = "dashed")) +
  ggspatial::annotation_scale(location = "br", width_hint = 0.25, pad_x = unit(1.8, "cm"),
                              unit_category = "metric", bar_cols = c("grey15", "white"),
                              text_cex = 0.7, text_pad = unit(0.2, "cm")) +
  ggspatial::annotation_north_arrow(location = "br", which_north = "true",
                                    height = unit(0.9, "cm"), width = unit(0.9, "cm"),
                                    style = ggspatial::north_arrow_fancy_orienteering(text_size = 7)) +
  coord_sf(xlim = site_fig_bbox[c("xmin", "xmax")], ylim = site_fig_bbox[c("ymin", "ymax")],
           crs = 3857, expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
        plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(order = 1, nrow = 1), linetype = guide_legend(order = 2))

# --- 7. Locator inset: park, the two basins, divide, and main-map extent -------
park_3857 <- st_transform(park_boundary, 3857)
inset_bbox <- st_bbox(st_buffer(park_3857, 3000))
site_inset <- ggplot() +
  geom_nps_basemap(inset_tiles) +
  geom_sf(data = park_3857, fill = NA, color = "seagreen4", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = basins_3857, aes(fill = basin), color = NA, alpha = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_sf(data = st_transform(continental_divide, 3857), color = "black", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_sf(data = st_as_sfc(site_fig_bbox), fill = NA, color = "red", linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("text", x = mean(inset_bbox[c("xmin", "xmax")]), y = inset_bbox["ymax"] - 9000,
           label = "Glacier National Park", fontface = "bold.italic", color = "seagreen4", size = 2.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = basin_cols) +
  coord_sf(xlim = inset_bbox[c("xmin", "xmax")], ylim = inset_bbox[c("ymin", "ymax")],
           crs = 3857, expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))

# --- 8. Join the inset to the main map (top-right corner of the panel) ---------
site_fig <- site_main +
  inset_element(site_inset, left = 0.67, bottom = 0.66, right = 0.99, top = 0.99, align_to = "panel")

site_fig

ggsave("data/park/GLAC/Figs/Site_Fig.jpg", site_fig, width = 7, height = 6.6, dpi = 600)
ggsave("data/park/GLAC/Figs/Inset_Site_Fig.jpg", site_inset, width = 3, height = 3, dpi = 600)
```

#### Example S & D Figure
```{r daily_use_demand_example}
sel_year <- 2025
plot_dat <- logan_sd %>%
  dplyr::mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(year == sel_year)
vis_dat <- logan_vis %>%
  dplyr::filter(year(ym) == sel_year)
inflow_dat <- wbm %>%
  dplyr::filter(year(date) == sel_year) %>%
  dplyr::select(date, inflow_gal, inflow_gal_low, inflow_gal_high)

vis_scale_factor <- max(vis_dat$LoganVisitors, na.rm = TRUE) /
                    max(c(plot_dat$supply_gal,
                          plot_dat$use_gal,
                          inflow_dat$inflow_gal_high), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.3

line_colors <- c(
  "Supply"     = pal$darkblue,
  "Use"        = pal$pink,
  "Inflow"     = pal$lightblue,
  "Visitation" = pal$gold
)
fill_colors <- c(
  "Inflow uncertainty" = pal$lightblue
)

# Base plot layers as a function so both main and inset share identical geometry
build_layers <- function() {
  list(
    geom_ribbon(
      data  = inflow_dat,
      aes(x = date, ymin = inflow_gal_low, ymax = inflow_gal_high,
          fill = "Inflow uncertainty"),
      alpha = 0.25
    ),
    geom_line(
      data = inflow_dat,
      aes(x = date, y = inflow_gal),
      linewidth = 1, color = "black"
    ),
    geom_line(
      data = inflow_dat,
      aes(x = date, y = inflow_gal, color = "Inflow"),
      linewidth = 0.8
    ),
    geom_line(aes(y = supply_gal), color = "black", linewidth = 1.2),
    geom_line(aes(y = supply_gal, color = "Supply"), linewidth = 0.8),
    geom_line(aes(y = use_gal), color = "black", linewidth = 1.2),
    geom_line(aes(y = use_gal, color = "Use"), linewidth = 0.8),
    geom_line(
      data = vis_dat,
      aes(x = ym, y = LoganVisitors / vis_scale_factor),
      color = "black", linewidth = 1
    ),
    geom_line(
      data = vis_dat,
      aes(x = ym, y = LoganVisitors / vis_scale_factor, color = "Visitation"),
      linewidth = 0.8
    ),
    scale_color_manual("", values = line_colors),
    scale_fill_manual("",  values = fill_colors)
  )
}

# Main plot
main_plot <- ggplot(plot_dat, aes(x = date)) +
  build_layers() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name     = "Gallons per Day",
    labels   = function(x) paste0(scales::comma(x / 1000), "k"),
    limits   = c(0, NA),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      transform = ~ . * vis_scale_factor,
      name      = "Monthly Visitors",
      labels    = function(x) paste0(scales::comma(x / 1000), "k")
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_date(labels = date_format("%b"), date_breaks = "1 month") +
  labs(x = "", title = paste("Logan Pass Water System —", sel_year)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    legend.margin      = margin(t = -10, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0),
    legend.key.width   = unit(1.5, "cm"),
    axis.title.y.left  = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = pal$gold),
    axis.text.y.right  = element_text(color = pal$gold),
    plot.title         = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
  )

# Inset plot — zoomed, stripped of secondary axis, title, and axis labels
inset_plot <- ggplot(plot_dat, aes(x = date)) +
  build_layers() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels  = function(x) paste0(scales::comma(x / 1000), "k"),
    limits  = c(0, 15000),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(        # must declare sec_axis to avoid ggplot error,
      transform = ~ . * vis_scale_factor,   # but we suppress its display below
      labels    = NULL
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_date(labels = date_format("%b %d"), date_breaks = "2 weeks") +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = as.Date(c(paste0(sel_year, "-08-01"),
                     paste0(sel_year, "-09-18"))),
    ylim = c(0, 15000)
  ) +
  labs(x = "", title = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position      = "none",
    plot.title           = element_blank(),
    axis.title           = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x          = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.y          = element_text(size = 7),
    # suppress right axis entirely
    axis.title.y.right   = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y.right    = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y.right   = element_blank(),
    plot.background      = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    plot.margin          = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
  )

# Combine
fin_plot <- main_plot + inset_element(inset_plot,
                           left   = 0.7,
                           bottom = 0.45,
                           right  = 0.99,
                           top    = 0.99)
ggsave("data/park/GLAC/Figs/sd_inflow_example_2025.jpg", plot = fin_plot, dpi = 600, width = 7, height = 3.5)
```

#### Operating Season
```{r operating_season}
# --- 1. Derive Historical Operating Season Start/End ---
season_summary <- logan_sd %>%
  group_by(year = year(date)) %>%
  summarize(
    start_date    = min(date),
    end_date      = max(date),
    duration_days = as.numeric(difftime(end_date, start_date, units = "days")),
    .groups       = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Normalize to a single reference year for aligned x-axis stacking
  mutate(
    plot_start = update(start_date, year = 2000),
    plot_end   = update(end_date,   year = 2000)
  )

# --- 2. Season Length Plot ---
sp <- ggplot(season_summary, aes(y = factor(year))) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = plot_start, xmax = plot_end),
                 size = 3, color = "seagreen", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(x = plot_end, label = paste0(duration_days, " days")),
            hjust = -0.2, size = 3.5, color = "grey30") +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b", date_breaks = "1 month",
               limits = c(as.Date(format(min(season_summary$plot_start), "%Y-06-01")),
                          NA)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Season Duration", x = "", y = "") +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), text = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 50, b = 10, l = 10))

sp


# --- 3. Future Operating Season Projection (DOY-averaged) ---
# Not run: start_date_mod is fit on SNOTEL June snow depth (june_snwd), which
# the WBM futures don't provide, and the result is only used in a commented-out
# plot layer below.
# fut_season_summary <- wbm %>%
#   dplyr::filter(year(date) %in% 2035:2064) %>%
#   dplyr::mutate(year = year(date),
#                 month = month(date)) %>%
#   group_by(year, CF) %>%
#   dplyr::summarize(
#     june_snowpack = mean(snowpack_in_wbm[month == 6], na.rm = TRUE),
#     .groups       = "drop"
#   ) %>%
#   dplyr::mutate(start_doy = predict(start_date_mod, newdata = .)) %>%
#   dplyr::mutate(plot_start = as.Date(start_doy - 1, origin = "2000-01-01")) 

all_season_summary <- wbm %>%
  dplyr::filter(year(date) > 2015, year(date) < 2026,
                month(date) > 4,   month(date) < 10) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    year              = year(date),
    tmean_F_s         = frollmean(tmean_F, 7),
    snowpack_in_wbm_s = frollmean(snowpack_in_wbm, 7),
    doy               = yday(date)) %>%
  left_join(snotel_tidy %>% dplyr::filter(name == "Flattop Mtn."),
            by = "date")

season_summary_stats <- all_season_summary %>%
  dplyr::mutate(year = year(date), month = month(date)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(year) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    june_tmean_F    = mean(tmean_F[month == 6],        na.rm = TRUE),
    june_snowpack   = mean(snowpack_in_wbm[month == 6], na.rm = TRUE),
    june_snwd       = mean(snwd_i[month == 6], na.rm = TRUE),
    sep_tmean_F     = mean(tmean_F[month == 9],        na.rm = TRUE),
    sep_precip      = min(prec_i[month == 9], na.rm = TRUE),
    sep_snowpack    = mean(snowpack_in_wbm[month == 9], na.rm = TRUE),
    sep_snwd        = mean(snwd_i[month == 9], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups         = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(season_summary, by = "year") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(start_doy = yday(start_date), end_doy = yday(end_date))

start_date_mod <- lm(start_doy ~ june_snwd, season_summary_stats)


# --- 4. Snowpack vs Season Timing Panel ---

# Here, we plot mean june snowpack vs opening date and cumulative precipitation
# on September 1 against closing date. Other variables were tested and these
# had the strongest relationships.
ggarrange(
  sp,
  ggplot(season_summary_stats, aes(x = june_snwd, y = plot_start)) +
    geom_point() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "seagreen") +
    #geom_point(data = fut_season_summary, aes(x = june_snowpack, y = plot_start, color = CF)) +
    theme_bw() + labs(y = "Opening Date", x = "Mean June\n Snowpack (in)"),
  ggplot(season_summary_stats, aes(x = sep_precip, y = plot_end)) +
    geom_point() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "seagreen") +
    theme_bw() + labs(y = "Closing Date", x = "Cumulative Precipitation \nSeptember 1 (in)"),
  nrow = 1
)


ggsave("data/park/GLAC/Figs/visitor_season.jpg", dpi = 600, width = 8, height = 2.5)

```

#### Water Budget

```{r wb_fig}
plot_dat <- wbm_annual %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  drop_partial_years() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    year, GCM, CF,
    "Precipitation (in)" = "precip_in_wbm",
    "Temperature (F)"    = "tmean_F",
    "AET (in)"           = "aet_in_wbm",
    "PET (in)"           = "pet_in_wbm",
    "Rain (in)"          = "rain_in_wbm",
    "Snow (in)"          = "snow_in_wbm",
    "Runoff (in)"        = "runoff_in_wbm",
    "Inflow (gal)"       = "inflow_open_months_gal"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-c(year, GCM, CF), names_to = "vars", values_to = "vals") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(vars, CF, GCM) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(roll_vals = data.table::frollmean(vals, 10, align = "center")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CF = factor(CF, levels = c("Historical", "Warm Wet", "Hot Dry")))

wb_fig <- ggplot(plot_dat) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = fut_yrs[1], xmax = fut_yrs[2], ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            fill = "grey85", linewidth = 0, alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = vals,      color = CF), lwd = 0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = roll_vals, group = CF),
            lineend = "round", color = "black", lwd = 1.5) +
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = roll_vals, color = CF), lineend = "round") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_cf() +
  scale_fill_cf() +
  labs(y = "", x = "") +
  facet_wrap(
    ~factor(vars, levels = c("Temperature (F)", "Precipitation (in)", "Rain (in)",
                              "Snow (in)", "PET (in)", "AET (in)", "Runoff (in)", "Inflow (gal)")),
    scales = "free", nrow = 2
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.margin = margin(t = -20, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0))

wb_fig

ggsave(wb_fig, filename = "data/park/GLAC/Figs/WaterBalance.tif",
       width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 600)
```

#### Annual Runoff Variability

```{r runoff_variability}
pdat <- wbm_annual %>%
  drop_partial_years() %>%
  dplyr::filter(year < 2100) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Runoff = runoff_cf)

hist_runoff  <- pdat[pdat$CF == "Historical" & in_hist(pdat$year), ]$Runoff
hist_median  <- median(hist_runoff, na.rm = TRUE) %>% as.numeric()
hist_q_low   <- quantile(hist_runoff, 0.1,  na.rm = TRUE) %>% as.numeric()
hist_q_high  <- quantile(hist_runoff, 0.9,  na.rm = TRUE) %>% as.numeric()
```

##### Extreme Event Figures

The next two figures use the same analytical workflow applied to different variables. A shared helper function avoids code duplication.

```{r extreme_event_helper}
# Computes 3-day rolling event frequency and intensity, and produces a bar chart figure.
# wbm_df  : the `wbm` daily data frame
# var_col : column name for the variable of interest (e.g., "precip_in_wbm")
# y_label : y-axis label for the plot
# Returns a named list: fig, year_counts, quantiles, stats
make_extreme_event_fig <- function(wbm_df, var_col, y_label) {
  q_low  <- 0.05
  q_high <- 0.99
  df <- wbm_df %>%
    dplyr::rename(cf = CF) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cf) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      rolling_3day = frollapply(.data[[var_col]], FUN = "sum", n = 3, align = "center"),
      date         = as_date(date),
      year         = year(date)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(rolling_3day))
  # Historical quantile thresholds (baseline period only)
  historic_q <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(cf == "Historical", rolling_3day > 0,
                  in_hist(year)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::summarize(
      QLOW  = quantile(rolling_3day, probs = q_low),
      QHIGH = quantile(rolling_3day, probs = q_high)
    )
  year_counts <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      low_day  = as.integer(rolling_3day <= historic_q$QLOW),
      high_day = as.integer(rolling_3day >= historic_q$QHIGH),
      year     = year(date)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cf, year) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(n_low_days  = sum(low_day),
                      n_high_days = sum(high_day),
                      max_3day    = max(rolling_3day, na.rm = TRUE),
                      .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      CF       = factor(cf, levels = c("Historical", "Hot Dry", "Warm Wet")),
      rect_min = ifelse(cf != "Historical", fut_yrs[1], hist_yrs[1]),
      rect_max = ifelse(cf != "Historical", fut_yrs[2], hist_yrs[2])
    )
  # Frequency + intensity stats over the relevant historical/future windows
  stats <- year_counts %>%
    dplyr::filter(in_window(year)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cf) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(
      count           = sum(n_high_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean            = mean(n_high_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_intensity   = max(max_3day, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  # % change in max intensity relative to Historical
  hist_max <- stats$max_intensity[stats$cf == "Historical"]
  stats <- stats %>%
    dplyr::mutate(pct_change_intensity = (max_intensity - hist_max) / hist_max * 100)
  fig <- ggplot(year_counts) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = rect_min, xmax = rect_max, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
              fill = "grey85", linewidth = 0, alpha = 0.1) +
    geom_bar(aes(x = year, y = n_high_days, fill = CF),
             stat = "identity", width = 0.9,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "", y = y_label) +
    scale_fill_cf() +
    # equal spacing per year across panels (Historical is shorter than the futures)
    facet_grid(~CF, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    theme(axis.text.x       = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
          strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "gray95"),
          strip.text         = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold")) +
    theme_legend_bottom
  list(fig = fig, year_counts = year_counts, quantiles = historic_q, stats = stats)
}
```

#### Seasonality

```{r figure_seasonal}
# Aggregate WBM to seasonal (Winter/Spring/Summer/Fall) × year × CF
sum_cols_s  <- c("aet_in_wbm", "melt_in_wbm", "pet_in_wbm", "rain_in_wbm",
                 "runoff_in_wbm", "snow_in_wbm", "precip_in_wbm", "runoff_gal", 
                 "runoff_cf")
mean_cols_s <- c("tmean_C", "inflow_gal")

seasonal_wbm <- wbm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    season = case_when(
      month(date) %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
      month(date) %in% c(3,  4, 5) ~ "Spring",
      month(date) %in% c(6,  7, 8) ~ "Summer",
      month(date) %in% c(9, 10,11) ~ "Fall"
    ),
    year = year(date)
  ) %>%
  filter_analysis_periods() %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(date, GCM)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(year, season, CF) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    across(all_of(sum_cols_s),  sum),
    across(all_of(mean_cols_s), mean),
    .groups = "keep"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CF = factor(CF, levels = c("Historical", "Hot Dry", "Warm Wet")))

# Seasonal runoff change statistics
seasonal_stats <- seasonal_wbm %>%
  dplyr::group_by(year, CF) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(runoff_fraction = 100 * runoff_in_wbm / sum(runoff_in_wbm)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF, season) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(runoff = mean(runoff_in_wbm), 
                   runoff_fraction = mean(runoff_fraction),
                   .groups = "keep") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF, season) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(runoff_fraction = sum(runoff_fraction), runoff = mean(runoff))

hist_seasonal <- seasonal_stats %>%
  dplyr::filter(CF == "Historical") %>%
  dplyr::rename(runoff_hist = runoff) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(season, runoff_hist)

seasonal_stats <- seasonal_stats %>%
  left_join(hist_seasonal, by = "season") %>%
  dplyr::filter(CF != "Historical") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(runoff_change = 100 * (runoff - runoff_hist) / runoff_hist)

# Helper: one seasonal boxplot panel
seasonal_box_panel <- function(data, y_col, y_label) {

    geom_boxplot(

          y = .data[[y_col]], fill = CF),
      outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.2
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "", y = y_label) +
    scale_fill_cf() +
    theme_legend_bottom
}
```

##### Snowmelt Runoff

Within the water balance model, runoff is generated through three mechanisms:

1. Precipitation can be directly routed to runoff. For logan pass, direct
routing is not activated (i.e., set to 0)

2. Precipitation that becomes rain can enter soil storage, subtract evaporative losses, and then what's left becomes runoff for that day.

3. Precipitation that becomes snow is stored in snow storage and melted through temperature modulated functions. That melt is routed to soil storage, evaporative losses are subtracted, and then it becomes runoff. 

Although soil storage and evaporation functions are applied equally to both daily rain and snowmelt inputs, therefore, by calculating daily contributing proportions of rain and snowmelt, we can estimate the fraction of runoff generated by each mechanism. Here we do that where:

melt_run = daily runoff produced from melt
rain_run = daily runoff produced from rain
melt_frac = melt_run / total_run
rain_frac = rain_run / total_run
total_run = melt_run + rain_run 

Note, if direct precip routing = 0, total_run is equal to runoff_in_wbm. 


```{r figure_snowmelt}

# Daily snowmelt fraction statistics (DOY × CF)
snowmelt_stats_d <- wbm %>%
  filter_analysis_periods() %>%                          # use shared helper for consistency
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_avail      = melt_in_wbm + rain_in_wbm,
    melt_run         = if_else(total_avail > 0,
                               (melt_in_wbm / total_avail) * runoff_in_wbm,
                               0),                       # protect against division by zero
    rain_run         = if_else(total_avail > 0,
                               (rain_in_wbm / total_avail) * runoff_in_wbm,
                               0),
    snow_frac_precip = if_else(precip_in_wbm > 0,
                               (precip_in_wbm - rain_in_wbm) / precip_in_wbm,
                               0),
    melt_frac        = if_else((melt_run + rain_run) > 0,
                               melt_run / (melt_run + rain_run),
                               0),
    rain_frac        = 1 - melt_frac,
    doy              = yday(date)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-total_avail) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(doy, CF) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    melt_frac_mean        = mean(melt_frac,        na.rm = TRUE),
    snow_frac_precip_mean = mean(snow_frac_precip, na.rm = TRUE),
    snowmelt              = mean(melt_in_wbm,      na.rm = TRUE),
    runoff                = mean(runoff_gal,        na.rm = TRUE),
    inflow                = mean(inflow_gal,        na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    snowmelt_mov = data.table::frollmean(snowmelt, 5, align = "center", na.rm = TRUE),
    runoff_mov   = data.table::frollmean(runoff,   5, align = "center", na.rm = TRUE),
    inflow_mov   = data.table::frollmean(inflow,   5, align = "center", na.rm = TRUE),
    doy_date     = as.Date(doy, origin = "2019-12-31"),
    # Shift Oct-Dec back one year so water-year axis starts in October
    wy_date      = if_else(month(doy_date) >= 10,
                           doy_date %m-% years(1),
                           doy_date)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CF = factor(CF, levels = c("Historical", "Warm Wet", "Hot Dry"))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Summary: mean annual melt fraction by CF
snowmelt_stats_summary <- snowmelt_stats_d %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(melt_frac_mean = mean(melt_frac_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
                   .groups = "drop")

# Peak timing by CF
peak_melt   <- snowmelt_stats_d %>% dplyr::group_by(CF) %>% slice_max(snowmelt_mov)
peak_runoff <- snowmelt_stats_d %>% dplyr::group_by(CF) %>% slice_max(runoff_mov)

# Annual melt fraction time series
snowmelt_stats_annual <- wbm_annual %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  drop_partial_years() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_avail      = melt_in_wbm + rain_in_wbm,
    melt_run         = if_else(total_avail > 0,
                               (melt_in_wbm / total_avail) * runoff_in_wbm,
                               0),
    rain_run         = if_else(total_avail > 0,
                               (rain_in_wbm / total_avail) * runoff_in_wbm,
                               0),
    snow_frac_precip = if_else(precip_in_wbm > 0,
                               (precip_in_wbm - rain_in_wbm) / precip_in_wbm,
                               0),
    melt_frac        = if_else((melt_run + rain_run) > 0,
                               melt_run / (melt_run + rain_run),
                               0),
    rain_frac        = 1 - melt_frac,
    CF               = factor(CF, levels = c("Historical", "Warm Wet", "Hot Dry"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-total_avail)

# Summary over analysis periods — uses shared helper for consistency
snowmelt_stats_annual %>%
  filter_analysis_periods() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(melt_frac_mean = mean(melt_frac, na.rm = TRUE),
                   .groups = "drop")

# Top figure - snowmelt fraction of runoff through time
sm_fraction_fig <- ggplot(snowmelt_stats_annual) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = fut_yrs[1], xmax = fut_yrs[2], ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            fill = "lightgrey", alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = melt_frac, group = CF), color = "black", lwd = 2, lineend = "round") +
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = melt_frac, color = CF), lwd = 1.5, lineend = "round") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Snowmelt Fraction of Runoff (-)") +
  scale_color_cf() +
  theme_legend_bottom

# --- Snowmelt Timing Figure (Water Year) ---
sm_timing_fig <- ggplot(snowmelt_stats_d, aes(x = wy_date, color = CF)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = snowmelt), alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = snowmelt_mov, group = CF), linewidth = 2, color = "black", lineend = "round") +
  geom_line(aes(y = snowmelt_mov), linewidth = 1.5, lineend = "round") +
  geom_vline(data = peak_melt,
             aes(color = CF, xintercept = wy_date, linetype = "Peak Melt"), lwd = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_cf("DOY Mean &\n5-Day\nRolling Mean") +
  scale_linetype_manual("", values = c(1)) +
  # Use %b to show only the short month name (Jan, Feb, etc.)
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b") +
  labs(y = "Mean Daily Snowmelt (in)", x = "") +
  theme_legend_bottom

# --- Inflow Timing Figure (Water Year) ---
dis_timing_fig <- ggplot(snowmelt_stats_d, aes(x = wy_date, color = CF)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = inflow), alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = inflow_mov, group = CF), linewidth = 2, color = "black", lineend = "round") +
  geom_line(aes(y = inflow_mov), linewidth = 1.5, lineend = "round") +
  geom_vline(data = peak_runoff,
             aes(color = CF, xintercept = wy_date, linetype = "Peak Runoff"), lwd = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_bw() +
  # Use %b to show only the short month name
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b") +
  scale_color_cf("DOY Mean &\n5-Day\nRolling Mean") +
  scale_linetype_manual("", values = c(1)) +
  labs(y = "Mean Daily Inflow (gallons)\n(Routed Runoff)", x = "") +
  theme_legend_bottom

sm_fig <- ggarrange(sm_fraction_fig, sm_timing_fig, dis_timing_fig,
                    ncol = 1, common.legend = TRUE, legend = "bottom", align = "hv")
```

```{r ds_figure}
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymax = DS_stress, ymin = DS, fill = CF), alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(aes(y = DS, group = CF), color = "black", linewidth = 2, lineend = "round") +
  geom_line(aes(y = DS, color = CF), linewidth = 1, lineend = "round") +
  theme_bw() + scale_y_log10() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0.2, linetype = 2) +
  scale_color_cf() + scale_fill_cf() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Annual D:S") +
  # equal spacing per year across panels (Historical is shorter than the futures)
  facet_grid(~CF, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x")

ds_fig <- ggarrange(monthly_ds_fig, annual_ds_fig,
                    ncol = 1, common.legend = TRUE, legend = "right")
ds_fig

ggsave(ds_fig, filename = "data/park/GLAC/Figs/ds.tif",
       dpi = 600, width = 7, height = 4)
```

#### Tank Storage

Track simulated tank storage through time to assess adequacy under different climate futures.

```{r tank_storage}
# Daily tank mass balance: each day the tank gains modeled inflow and loses
# demand, capped between empty and full; any shortfall below empty is a
# deficit. The tank starts full on January 1 (it refills over the winter,
# when there is no demand), then runs continuously through the year.
calc_storage_daily <- function(sup_vec, dem_vec, cap) {
  level <- numeric(length(sup_vec)); deficit <- numeric(length(sup_vec))
  prev <- cap
  for (i in seq_along(sup_vec)) {
    potential  <- prev + sup_vec[i] - dem_vec[i]
    level[i]   <- max(0, min(cap, potential))
    deficit[i] <- max(0, -potential)
    prev       <- level[i]
  }
  data.frame(level = level, deficit = deficit)
}

# Daily demand: monthly use (with the operating-season mask) spread evenly
# over the days of the month
daily_use <- monthly_use %>%
  dplyr::transmute(ym,
                   use_low  = monthly_use_low  / days_in_month(ym),
                   use_mid  = monthly_use_mid  / days_in_month(ym),
                   use_high = monthly_use_high / days_in_month(ym))

tank_periods <- c("Recent Historical (2015-2025)", "Mid-Century (2045-2054)",
                  "Late-Century (2090-2099)")

tank_dat <- wbm %>%
  dplyr::select(date, CF, inflow_gal, inflow_gal_low, inflow_gal_high) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(year = year(date), ym = floor_date(date, "month"),
                plot_group = dplyr::case_when(
                  CF == "Historical" & year >= 2015 & year <= 2025 ~ tank_periods[1],
                  CF != "Historical" & year >= 2045 & year <= 2054 ~ tank_periods[2],
                  CF != "Historical" & year >= 2090 & year <= 2099 ~ tank_periods[3])) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(plot_group)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(daily_use, by = "ym") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(CF, date)

# Scenarios (supply, demand): average = mid inflow and mid demand; high
# stress = low inflow and high demand; low stress = high inflow and low demand
simulate_tank <- function(cap) {
  tank_dat %>%
    dplyr::group_by(CF, year) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(~ {
      avg  <- calc_storage_daily(.x$inflow_gal,      .x$use_mid,  cap)
      high <- calc_storage_daily(.x$inflow_gal_low,  .x$use_high, cap)
      low  <- calc_storage_daily(.x$inflow_gal_high, .x$use_low,  cap)
      .x %>% dplyr::mutate(avg_level = avg$level,  avg_deficit = avg$deficit,
                           high_stress_level = high$level, high_stress_deficit = high$deficit,
                           low_stress_level  = low$level,  low_stress_deficit  = low$deficit)
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(doy = yday(date)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(CF, plot_group, doy) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(across(c(avg_level, high_stress_level, low_stress_level,
                              avg_deficit, high_stress_deficit, low_stress_deficit), mean),
                     .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(tank_gal   = cap,
                  date_plot  = as.Date(doy - 1, origin = "2020-01-01"),
                  plot_group = factor(plot_group, levels = tank_periods),
                  CF         = factor(CF, levels = c("Historical", "Hot Dry", "Warm Wet")))
}

tank_10k <- simulate_tank(10000)
tank_50k <- simulate_tank(50000)

# Summary for the text: days per year the tank is empty, and annual deficit,
# during the operating season (June-September)
tank_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(tank_10k, tank_50k) %>%
  dplyr::filter(month(date_plot) %in% 6:9) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(tank_gal, CF, plot_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    min_avg_level        = min(avg_level),
    min_high_stress      = min(high_stress_level),
    empty_days_avg       = sum(avg_level < 1),
    empty_days_high      = sum(high_stress_level < 1),
    deficit_gal_avg      = sum(avg_deficit),
    deficit_gal_high     = sum(high_stress_deficit),
    first_empty_avg      = suppressWarnings(min(date_plot[avg_level < 1])),
    first_empty_high     = suppressWarnings(min(date_plot[high_stress_level < 1])),
    .groups = "drop")
save_table(tank_summary, "table_tank_storage")
tank_summary

tank_fig <- function(d) {
  ggplot(d %>% dplyr::filter(month(date_plot) %in% 5:10), aes(x = date_plot, fill = CF)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = high_stress_level, ymax = low_stress_level), alpha = 0.3, lwd = 0) +
    geom_line(aes(y = avg_level, group = CF), color = "black", lwd = 1.5) +
    geom_line(aes(y = avg_level, color = CF), lwd = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~plot_group) +
    labs(y = "Tank Level (gallons)", x = "",
         title = paste0(scales::comma(unique(d$tank_gal)), "-gallon tank")) +
    theme_bw() +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b", date_breaks = "1 month") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, limits = c(0, NA)) +
    scale_color_cf() +
    scale_fill_cf() +
    theme_legend_bottom +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))
}

track_storage_fig    <- tank_fig(tank_10k)
track_storage_fig_50 <- tank_fig(tank_50k)
track_storage_fig

ggsave(track_storage_fig, filename = "data/park/GLAC/Figs/track_storage_10kgal.tif",
       dpi = 600, width = 7, height = 2.5)
ggsave(track_storage_fig_50, filename = "data/park/GLAC/Figs/track_storage_50kgal.tif",
       dpi = 600, width = 7, height = 2.5)
```
